venue.name: SETU Arena
venue.address: South East Technological University West Campus, Carriganore, Co. Waterford. X91 XD96

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnRyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6168ff3debe6e6fb0d390d1aee873034e58c6840/Untitled-4%20(1).webp)

**Please Note:** As this is Ireland's National Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Free T-Shirt** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum of 6 Irish competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough Irish competitors.

**Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's Irish Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionshipFMC2024) on 29th June instead.

items.name: Philippine Championship 2024
items.information:
**Welcome to Philippine Championship 2024**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaUptIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83c2243f7adc84cc345f644f4e96f36b9b9078db/White%20PhilChamp%20Shadow.png)

**Please Note**
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome,

There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Philippine Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Philippines in each category

Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, PCA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event.
Please read the WCA rules and regulations.
Please check the Competitor Guide and Updates tab regarding changes.
Please check Events and Schedules tabs for more information.
Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and ID.

***Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.***

items.name: Cajun Cube Clash 2024
items.information:
This competition takes place on a Friday

Successful registration for this competition will waive the registration fee for [Southern FMC Championships 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernFMCChampionship2024) on Saturday, July 6, 2024

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!

To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com.

- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CajunCubeClash2024#35056-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CajunCubeClash2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
